command: cursor-agent --trust --force --print --output-format json 'Quote the tower notice injected at session start verbatim, then run atc whoami --json exactly once and include its unmodified JSON output. Do not edit files or use other tools.'
quoted_notice:
tower (`atc`) keeps this repository's board. A flight is one unit of work for a person or an agent, stored in the repository beside history and moved from the shell. tower runs nothing: you pull work, fly it, and report back.

`atc` shows the board. `atc next` claims the next ready flight for you and names the skill it is flown with. `atc brief <flight>` is everything on record about one. `atc hold <flight> -m "<question>"` stops on a question only a person can answer. `atc done <flight>` finishes.

Every verb's own `--help` is the authority on it.

Nothing filed here yet. Run `atc`.
